text:
*I scanned 3 clusters and 41 workloads and found 23 things to look at.* Two are worth fixing first:

- `critical` seeded-b and -c admit privileged pods · Any workload can escape to the node; enforce baseline Pod Security.
- `major` seeded-c is a minor version behind its channel · Upgrade the control plane before the channel's end of support.

*3 more worth a look*
No PDB on payments-api
A node drain takes every replica down at once.
`minor` Default namespace holds workloads
Move them into a namespace of their own.
Workload Identity is off on one node pool
Pods there use the node's service account.
